reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to USD 60 million (EUR 52 million) in favour of TAV Kazakhstan LLP, a special purpose vehicle incorporated in Kazakhstan, and its two operating subsidiaries Almaty International Airport JSC, which owns the eponymous airport, and Venus Trading LLP, which provides refuelling services (jointly, the "Co-Borrowers"). The transaction is an extension in form of an additional tranche of Project ID 51186 signed in September 2021 that enabled acquisition of AIA and construction of an international passenger terminal (the "Original Transaction") by TAV Havalimanlari Holding A.S. (TAV Holding) and Kazakhstan Infrastructure Fund (jointly, the "Sponsors"). In terms of passenger numbers, ALA is the biggest airport in Central Asia (served 11.4 million passengers in 2024). With the construction of a new international terminal under the Original Transaction, growing traffic in the coming years, additional investments are required to ensure compliance with international safety standards. Under the current proposal, EBRD will co-finance an investment programme of USD 420 million (EUR 361 million) to modernise and upgrade airside infrastructure, including runways, taxiways, aprons, and pavement.
